RFP Library 5-year Strategic Plan

RFP- Douglas County Public Library, A New Five-Year Strategic Plan 2028 to 2033 
Posted- 11/2/2026 
Bids due- 11/20/2026 

Looking for a company or organization to help with the planning process of a new library strategic plan for the Douglas County Public Library. 

Description:  Planning process 
Early 2027- help with the development process of a new strategic plan including the following starting in January 2027 

1. Internal and External Stakeholder- small group interviews
2. Community survey- digital and paper.  Use of the 2022 Survey as a “Base Comparison” with new questions as needed.  Data input of surveys and summary analysis of the information.
3. Collection and analysis of various socio-demographic, economic, and housing characteristics,
4. Up to three strategic planning workshops (if needed) conduction of workshops with summary and analysis
a. Workshop 1- community and organizational assessment with the development of draft key elements (core values, mission/vision, goals, etc.)
b. Workshop 2 & Workshop 3 (if needed) Refinement and development of the final key elements
5. Development/Completion of a technical report
6. Create a 2028 plan for implementation

Four separate annual evaluations and updates: 
2029, 2030, 2031, 2032
 
Development/completion of four technical reports (summaries) 
Proposal based on services provided 

Contact information 
Timothy DeGhelder- Library Director 
Questions and proposals can be emailed to the following address [email protected] 
The current strategic plan can be viewed at the current webpage: https://shorturl.at/60Fiz

SOLICITATION OF BIDS
Jobs Peak WTP PLC Replacement Project
Jobs Peak PLC Project.pdf

Sealed bids for the construction of the Jobs Peak WTP PLC Replacement Project will be received by Douglas County via the Douglas County Board of Commissioners, at the office of Douglas County Public Works, 1120 Airport Rd. #F-2, Minden, NV 89423, until 2:00 p.m. local time on Thursday, July 30, 2026, at which time the Bids received will be publicly opened and read. Bids received after the aforementioned time will not be opened or considered.

The Project generally consists of installing a replacement programmable logic controller (PLC) at the Jobs Peak Water Treatment Plant.

Bidding Documents may be examined and obtained electronically via Quest Construction Data Network (www.questcdn.com), project number 10241318.

A pre-bid conference will be held at 10:00 a.m. local time on Monday, July 20, 2026, at the office of Douglas County Public Works, 1120 Airport Rd. #F-2, Minden, NV 89423. Attendance is highly encouraged but not mandatory.

The Engineer's estimate for this work is $81,000.00.

No proposal will be considered unless accompanied by a bid security in the form of a Bid Bond in an amount not less than five percent (5%) of the bid.

The Prevailing Wage Rate as established by the State Labor Commission shall be paid on projects with a contract price of $100,000 or more. The State Labor Commissioner has assigned Public Works Project Number DO-2026-436 to this project.

NRS 338.147 provides for a five percent (5%) bidder preference to bidders who establish that they qualify for the preference.

The last date for submitting questions to the Owner to be addressed by Addendum is Friday, July 24, 2026.

Bidders may direct bid-related questions to:
Christine Larrance, PE
Douglas County Public Works
775-783-6026
[email protected]

Douglas County reserves the right to reject any and all bids and to waive irregularities in the bids.		2026/07/152026/07/20View Details
